propositions: The tests overlay is currently selected only by glob match on test file paths, missing source-only changes that add declarations without corresponding tests
A new content-triggered detector must fire when a diff adds a declaration (function/class/method) and no changed file matches the tests globs, independent of language or repository layout

The detector must distinguish added declarations from annotation rewrites (same name added and removed in one file) and skip anonymous declarations, while using per-file provenance to handle moves as separate add+delete
Guard (vii) must narrow coverage-gap findings to block only when new behaviour is implemented in added lines and a concrete violating input is named in the finding
The trigger mechanism must pass changed_files through content_triggered_overlays and compose_diff_context to enable the negative rule (no test file changed)
Implementation must reuse the existing polyglot _REMOVED_DECL_RE regex across Python, Go, Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript and other languages without layout assumptions
